journal.text: Initial deployment 2025-07-01 ($45.5k of $50k, ~$4.5k cash buffer). Momentum-tilted large-cap basket: NVDA, MSFT, META, AVGO (all at/near highs after strong Apr-Jun recovery), NFLX, AMZN, GOOGL, AMD, PLTR, plus defensives COST, WMT. Rationale: broad uptrend since April lows; diversify across AI/semis, platforms, consumer staples. Reconsider: trim any position down >12% from entry or breaking below its 50-day trend; add new monthly deposit (Aug 1) to leaders or diversify into lagging sectors if tech rolls over.
